name: What is involved in the process of getting a wheelchair ramp repaired by City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the process of getting a wheelchair ramp repaired by City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our repair process typically begins with an initial consultation and on-site inspection to assess the damage and identify necessary repairs. Following the assessment, we provide a detailed estimate outlining the scope of work, materials, and cost. Once approved, our team schedules and executes the repair, ensuring the ramp meets safety standards and functions correctly. We communicate with you throughout the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves an on-site inspection, a detailed estimate, scheduling, and execution of the repair work, with ongoing communication.
